items.name: Lon Lon Milk Bottle
items.requirement: Win Talon's Super Cucco game (find 3 Cuccos in 30 seconds, 10 rupees)

items.name: Empty Bottle (Cucco Lady)
items.requirement: Return all 7 Cuccos to the pen

items.name: Bottle with Ruto's Letter
items.location: Lake Hylia - Lake floor near underwater tunnel exit
items.requirement: Silver Scale (dive deeper), show letter to King Zora
items.reward: Empty Bottle (letter delivered to King Zora)

items.name: Empty Bottle (Poe Collector)
items.location: Hyrule Castle Town - Poe Collector shop (old guard room)
items.requirement: Capture and sell 5 Big Poes (100 points each = 500 points total)
items.notes: Requires Epona, Fairy Bow, and at least one empty bottle to start. 10 Big Poes total in Hyrule Field; selling all 10 (1000 points) gives Gold Rupee (200 rupees)

songs.name: Serenade of Water

great_fairy_fountains.notes: In remake, all Great Fairies require rupee offerings. Play Zelda's Lullaby on Triforce symbol to summon.

fountains.name: Great Fairy of Power (Death Mountain Summit)
fountains.location: Death Mountain Trail summit, bomb cracked wall near Kaepora Gaebora
fountains.notes: Most important fountain; magic meter required for all spells/magic items. Din's Fire needed for Shadow Temple entrance.

fountains.name: Great Fairy of Power (Hyrule Castle)
fountains.location: Hyrule Castle grounds, path to castle, bomb boulder at dead end
fountains.notes: Child only - castle grounds inaccessible as Adult

fountains.name: Great Fairy of Magic (Zora's Fountain)
fountains.location: Zora's Fountain, back wall near Jabu-Jabu, bomb cracked wall

fountains.name: Great Fairy of Wisdom (Death Mountain Crater)
fountains.location: Death Mountain Crater western side, smash boulders with Megaton Hammer

fountains.name: Great Fairy of Magic (Desert Colossus)
fountains.location: Desert Colossus north side, bomb cracked wall near Spirit Temple

fountains.name: Great Fairy of Courage (Outside Ganon's Castle)
fountains.location: Road to Ganon's Castle, lift heavy pillar with Golden Gauntlets
fountains.requirement: Golden Gauntlets (from inside Ganon's Castle Shadow Barrier)
fountains.reward: Double Defense (damage halved, white heart outline)

items.name: Silver Gauntlets
items.requirement: Complete Child Link portion of Spirit Temple

items.name: Golden Gauntlets
items.requirement: Complete Shadow Barrier trial inside Ganon's Castle
items.ability: Lift extremely heavy black granite pillars

capacity_upgrades.notes: Max capacity upgrades for Deku items and ammunition. Giant's Wallet from 100 Skulltulas.

tiers.source: Goron City rolling game OR Hyrule Castle Town Bombchu Bowling
Goron City rolling game OR Hyrule Castle Town Bombchu Bowling (second location)
Gerudo Training Grounds (Adult, 1500 rupees entry fee)
Adult's Wallet (from House of Skulltula after 10 Gold Skulltulas)
Giant's Wallet (from House of Skulltula after 100 Gold Skulltulas)

items.name: Golden Scale
items.ability: Dive to maximum depth (8 seconds underwater)

items.name: Biggoron's Sword
items.ability: Two-handed sword with double Master Sword damage, never breaks
items.notes: Trading sequence: Pocket Egg → Pocket Cucco → Cojiro → Odd Mushroom → Odd Potion → Poacher's Saw → Broken Goron's Sword → Prescription → Eyeball Frog → Eyedrops → Claim Check → Biggoron's Sword
